entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something. I got an order last week and... it's just not right. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?
Oh, okay, hold on. It's... VF-9827-5514.

Thank you. I see the order here for one Pro-Series jersey, delivered on January 13th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the jersey. It's the wrong size. I followed the chart on the website, I think, but it's just way too tight. I can barely get it on. The whole website was a bit confusing.

I understand, and I'm sorry to hear the fit wasn't what you expected. Sizing can sometimes be tricky. Since you received it just 7 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel. We can definitely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, good. I was so worried. I don't know how any of this works. Can't you just help me? What do I do next?
Of course. I'm here to walk you through it. We have two options: we can process a full refund, or we can set up an exchange for the next size up. Do you have a preference?
I really like the jersey, it's just the size. An exchange would be perfect.

Excellent. I can initiate that exchange right now. I'm sending an email to you with a prepaid return label. Just print that out, place the jersey that's too tight back in its original packaging or any suitable mailer, and drop it off at the post office. Once the tracking shows it's on its way back to us, we'll ship out the new size to you.
Oh, wow, that's it? That sounds much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, David.
You're very welcome. The email has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
